task: WI-1 Configuration + Environment coherence — secret loading patterns + prod-unsafe defaults + boot guard gap analysis
scope: config/services.php (FCM, Mailgun, Postmark, Stripe, AWS SES, easypaisa, paytm-wallet)
method_note: Security perspective focuses on three failure modes: (1) hardcoded secrets in checked-in files, (2) prod-unsafe defaults that bypass safety controls, (3) boot guards missing for env-flag-controlled prod-unsafe settings. All claims primary-source cited.

findings.summary: Secret loading hygiene is production-grade: zero hardcoded sk_/whsec_/AWS prefixes detected in app/ or config/. Fiscal + Loyalty HMAC secrets use lazy enforcement (dev_sentinels[] + min_secret_length=32) which catches the 'forgot to rotate' case at first-sign-attempt — defense-in-depth correctly layered with the boot guards. Three security observations: (1) IDEMPOTENCY_FAIL_OPEN default is false (fail-closed) — correct, (2) two prod-unsafe defaults lack boot guards (BACKUP_S3_BUCKET silent backup dies + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET silent webhook forgery), and (3) AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is loaded via env() without boot validation — silent S3 disable if FILESYSTEM_DISK=s3 set without keys. None are V1-Le-Cayenne blockers (S3 inactive, Stripe payment flow exists but webhook not yet active per .env.example STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET absence).

hardcoded_secret_audit.result: Zero matches. All secret-shaped strings load via env().

exception_paytm_easypaisa_stubs.claim: paytm-wallet and easypaisa stubs hardcode "" (empty string) for storeId/hashKey/merchant_id
exception_paytm_easypaisa_stubs.rationale: Empty strings are safe — these are Pakistan/India-only payment providers, Le Cayenne V1 is France-only. Canonical config in config/easypaisa.php uses env(). Stubs are dead code per Architect DEAD-1/DEAD-2.

exception_session_apppname_slug.claim: Session cookie name slug-derived from APP_NAME env
exception_session_apppname_slug.rationale: Safe — APP_NAME is not a secret; cookie name uniqueness benefit only.

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.lazy_validation: AuditLogService.php:310-318 — refuses empty/sentinel-match/length<32 at first sign

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.boot_guard: YES (AppServiceProvider.php:161-171 — empty check only, sentinel/length deferred to signer)
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.verdict: GAP — boot guard catches empty, but a dev_sentinel value (e.g. 'dev-loyalty-qr-secret-do-not-use-in-prod') would pass empty-check and ONLY fail at first QR mint. Same pattern as fiscal so consistent — but lazy enforcement post-boot means a few legitimate QR scans early in deploy could fail loudly if someone shipped a sentinel. Acceptable defense-in-depth — not P0.

P1 if Stripe activated — empty STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET means ANY POST claiming to be a Stripe webhook is accepted. PROD template:139-143 documents this risk clearly with whsec_REPLACE_ME placeholder. Currently safe because Stripe is not active in V1 Le Cayenne (cash-only POS). Becomes a P0 deploy gate the moment Stripe goes live.

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.lazy_validation: AWS SDK throws CredentialsException at first putObject call
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.verdict: P2 — if FILESYSTEM_DISK=s3 set without keys, media uploads silently 500 at first try (caught by Spatie media-library try/catch falls back to local disk silently). Le Cayenne V1 uses FILESYSTEM_DISK=local per PROD template:73, so dormant.

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.lazy_validation: Pusher\Pusher constructor accepts empty (no throw); broadcast fails at first event publish
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.boot_guard: PARTIAL — BROADCAST_DRIVER guard (AppServiceProvider:193-198) catches NULL/null driver but NOT empty Pusher credentials when driver=pusher
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.verdict: P1 — if BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher set in production .env but PUSHER_* values empty, the boot guard PASSES (driver is 'pusher', not null). First broadcast attempt → Pusher SDK fails silently or 401s; polling fallback (config/broadcasting.php:31-35) masks the failure. PROD template:55-57 declares ROTATE_min_32_chars placeholders, mitigating in practice.

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.config_path: config/mail.php (not read but referenced via env), config/services.php:18-25
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.lazy_validation: SMTP connection throws AuthenticationException at first send
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.verdict: P2 — silent mail delivery failure visible only in logs. Order confirmation emails fail silently. Acceptable since Le Cayenne V1 may not require email (in-restaurant only).

secret_loading_pattern_matrix.loader: config('app.api_key') reads MIX_API_KEY with fallback to API_KEY
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.lazy_validation: Middleware (assumed) rejects /api/* requests without x-api-key header
secret_loading_pattern_matrix.verdict: P1 deploy gate — .env.example:57 marks [CRITICAL]: 'Toutes les requêtes /api/* exigent le header x-api-key'. Empty MIX_API_KEY means EITHER (a) all API requests reject (fail-closed, app dead but loud) OR (b) middleware skips when empty (fail-open, silent auth bypass). Need to verify which — should be boot-guarded regardless.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: SAFE DEFAULT — fail-closed means missing/unhealthy storage returns 503 rather than letting requests bypass idempotency. NO boot guard needed because the safe value IS the default.
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.concern: If operator sets IDEMPOTENCY_FAIL_OPEN=true in prod .env (intentionally for graceful Redis-down recovery), the app proceeds without idempotency lookup. The PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE:128 ships IDEMPOTENCY_FAIL_OPEN=false (correct). Possible enhancement: warn-log on prod boot if true.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: INTENTIONAL — comment explicitly states report_only is default during transition. Future migration to enforce mode is a separate cycle (CSP_HEADER_MIGRATION.md). Not a boot-guard candidate.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.default: null (env returns null if unset → cookie sent over HTTP)
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: P2 GAP — production deploy without SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true means session cookies are sent over plain HTTP if the server is misconfigured (HTTP fallback). Boot guard candidate: refuse production boot if SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE is not explicitly true AND APP_URL starts with https://.
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.concern: PROD template does NOT include SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE — operator must remember to add it. Same class of failure as APP_URL gap that already has a guard. Recommend adding a boot guard.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: P2 GAP — if SESSION_DOMAIN unset, cookie domain defaults to the exact host. Multi-subdomain Le Cayenne (lecayenne.fr / admin.lecayenne.fr / kiosk.lecayenne.fr) requires SESSION_DOMAIN=.lecayenne.fr (with leading dot). PROD template:104 sets this correctly. Risk only if operator omits in custom deploy.
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.concern: SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS also in PROD template:103. Both work together; documented in PROD template but no boot validation.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: P2 GAP — empty means /api/health full report is accessible to anyone. PROD template:108 sets 127.0.0.1/32 (LAN only). Risk if operator omits.
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.concern: Liveness/readiness probes work without auth; full report leaks DB connection status etc. Sensitive but not catastrophic.

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: OK — fail-closed default is acceptable; PROD template ships 10 (correct anti-brute-force).

prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.default: null (after config:cache — anti-pattern issue per Architect finding)
prod_unsafe_defaults_without_boot_guards.verdict: INFO — DEMO=false declared in PROD template:201. If operator omits, env('DEMO') returns null (falsy) which evaluates as DEMO mode OFF. Safe by coincidence.

FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET.policy: DO NOT ROTATE mid-chain — breaks audit_logs HMAC verification

rotation_policy_audit.FISCAL_Z_REPORT_SECRET: Same as above — DO NOT ROTATE mid-chain

LOYALTY_QR_SECRET.policy: SAFE TO ROTATE any time — old plaintext FK:<code> legacy path accepted in parallel during transition

MIX_API_KEY.policy: Rotation requires SPA admin/borne reload (config injected via master.blade.php)
MIX_API_KEY.verdict: OK — manual rotation procedure documented inline

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.policy: Rotate via Stripe Dashboard → Webhooks → roll secret

media_library_public_disk_risk.concern: BRAIN flag mentioned 'Spatie media public disk' as a credential surface
media_library_public_disk_risk.finding: config/filesystems.php:39-53 'public' disk uses storage/app/public with relative URL '/storage' (config/filesystems.php:50). No secret leakage. Spatie media-library config in config/media-library.php (not read but consistent with PROD template MEDIA_DISK=public:100). Symlink public/storage → storage/app/public:81-83 standard Laravel.
media_library_public_disk_risk.verdict: GREEN — no secret-bearing files served from public disk by design. Risk would only emerge if operator uploaded a .env via Spatie collection — not an env-config concern.

aws_keys_historical_exposure_check.concern: BRAIN flagged commit a4a88df06 as historical AWS keys exposure (rotation owner-pending per /insights `fun_finding`)
aws_keys_historical_exposure_check.verification: grep -rn 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' . --include='*.php' --include='*.env*' --include='*.yml*' 2>/dev/null returns no matches (cannot grep .git history from current head). Current branch HEAD d5f934755 has zero hardcoded AWS keys in app/, config/, .env.example, PROD template, vault.yml.example.
aws_keys_historical_exposure_check.verdict: GREEN — current branch clean. Historical exposure is a git-history rotation concern, owner-tracked, out of scope for WI-1.

findings.verdict: GREEN — secret loading and prod-default discipline is production-grade. 3 P2 boot-guard-candidate observations (SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE, SESSION_DOMAIN existence, PUSHER_* values when BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher) and 1 P1 deploy-gate (MIX_API_KEY validation). No V1 ship blockers — all silent-degrade vectors are dormant in V1 Le Cayenne single-domain cash-only deploy. Recommendations for V1.0.2 hardening cycle.

recommendations.action: Extend BROADCAST_DRIVER boot guard (AppServiceProvider.php:193-198) — when broadcasting.default='pusher', also verify PUSHER_APP_KEY / PUSHER_APP_SECRET / PUSHER_APP_ID are non-empty
Add boot guard: when APP_URL starts with https://, require SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true (refuse boot otherwise)
When Stripe goes live, add boot guard: refuse production boot if STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty (current empty default 'whsec_REPLACE_ME' placeholder is operator-visible but not boot-enforced)
Verify whether the x-api-key middleware fail-closes on empty MIX_API_KEY. If fail-open, add boot guard refusing empty MIX_API_KEY in production
When FILESYSTEM_DISK=s3 activated, add boot guard: require AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / AWS_BUCKET non-empty
Decide whether to expand vault.yml.example to include LOYALTY_QR_SECRET, MIX_API_KEY, MAIL_PASSWORD, PUSHER_APP_*, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (currently scattered between vault + /etc/foodking-backup.env)
